SMTO-CTX-0048 — SMTO asked to open a file the wrong way

GUID: e522bb2f-00e4-5da8-bd77-6dc012ea55a4
Slug: attachment-invalid-arguments
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: attachments

What happened

  • SMTO's assistant made a mistake in how it asked to open a file, for example pointing to the file in two ways at once. Nothing was opened or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If the task is still running, let it continue. SMTO is told exactly what was wrong and normally asks again correctly. This was a mistake in how the request to open the file was written, not a problem with your file.
  2. If the task fails, send your request again and name the file you want opened exactly as it appears in the conversation. A clear file name helps SMTO point to the file in one way only.
  3. If it keeps happening, ask the person who manages SMTO to check the model under Settings › Setup › Model routing. A model that often writes these requests wrongly may not suit work with files.

What success looks like

  • SMTO opens the file and its answer uses the file's contents.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep resending the exact same request if it fails the same way each time.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A file, document or Vision reader call violated its argument schema or gave both (or neither) of the alternative sources (path or context_id; context_id or artifact_ids) instead of exactly one.

What this means

  • Arguments violate the reader schema or provide both alternative source types instead of exactly one. Validation does not broaden source access. Diagnostic presentation does not grant access, change task configuration or establish the outcome of earlier operations.

Why this can happen

  • Arguments violate the reader schema or provide both alternative source types instead of exactly one. Validation does not broaden source access.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the exact error kind and retained source or route receipt. Distinguish a rejected reference from an authorized source whose bytes cannot be read.

How to fix it

  • validate_source in src/agent_runtime/native/attachment_tools.py (or Vision execute) rejected the arguments before permission evaluation; read the schema message in the tool result and resend with exactly one permitted source (path or context_id; context_id or artifact_ids for Vision) and supported options. This is normally a model tool-call error the agent corrects on its next step; validation never broadens source access.
  • Inspect the tool schema and provide exactly one permitted source, with supported options.

Retry and execution caution

  • Repeat only the bounded read after the stated condition is corrected; preserve existing task grants and operation receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The arguments validate and the source separately passes task authorization.

What not to do

  • Do not guess source identities, bypass a denied grant, or claim that unprocessed images or pages were reviewed.

Technical notes

  • Observation text and document contents are untrusted data. Existing skill grants, cancellation and resource limits still apply.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
